text:
anna: heads up — customer X reported their private VPC canary drifted to 100% old version after we flipped the split. :warning: logs show control-plane claimed rollout succeeded but nodes still serving v1.2.1

mike: hmm, which path did the private control plane use to push configs? S3 proxy or local bundle sync?

anna: private control plane -> customer s3 proxy (air-gapped path) -> node agents. We saw a bunch of 503s in the proxy logs around the flip window. pasted snippet: `ERROR fetchBundle 503 service-unavailable retry=5`

sasha: deploy-bot shows canary-split change at 1853456720 -> `canary: 10% -> 50%` and then at 1853456739 it reverted traffic back to old variant for many seat IDs. :eyes:

deploy-bot: deploy event: canary update v1.2.2 deployed to dedicated pool; rollout state=COMMITTED; audit=anno-1853456712

oleg: likely cause: our reconciliation assumes eventual fetch within N retries, but air-gapped proxies sometimes drop requests and backoff pushes application of config much later. We need stronger guards for canary (ACK-based) instead of optimistic flip.

tina: also saw KMS logs; some nodes blocked waiting for key unwrap from customer HSM when verifying signature on bundle. If the HSM channel timed out, agent left older config live.

mike: suggested short-term mitigation: make control plane wait for >=M node-acks before marking canary 'in-progress' as success. That means change API semantics: POST /rollouts/{id}/probe -> returns ack_count. psuedo: `POST /v1/internal/rollouts/1853456712/ack?min=3`

sarah: +1 on ack gating but we should surface per-az ack progress in the console and also a time-to-fallback timer. Don't let a stuck canary silently drain production traffic.

anna: UX idea: console shows a live matrix: AZ rows x pool columns with green/yellow/red and a 'force-sync' button that logs who clicked it. Force-sync should be behind an audit and require opt-in flag.

oleg: instrumentation we need now: rollout.reconciler.latency (histogram), rollout.node.applied_version (gauge with tag node_id), and rollout.stale_config_count. Add alert: if >10% nodes still on older version after 5m, trigger paging.

mike: for air-gapped customers add a small lightweight "strobe" ping: control plane -> agent small header-only bundle to validate reachability before flipping traffic. If strobe fails, abort and extend canary window.

tina: watch out for HSM-unwrap hot paths if we add more pings — might increase HSM load. Suggest a cached verification token with short TTL so we don't hit HSM per strobe. Security sign-off needed.

anna: action items: 1) oleg + mike to draft ACK gating PR + metrics (feature-flagged) 2) mike to add strobe ping prototype 3) tina to propose cached verification token model 4) sasha/sarah to add temporary dashboard widgets and a paging rule. I'll open a tracking ticket and include a shortplay for SRE.

sasha: looping @eng-oncall for visibility. For now customers with air-gapped proxies: recommend manual slow ramp and enable extra monitoring.

mike: I'll also add a reconcile-debug endpoint: `GET /internal/reconcile/status?rollout=1853456712` that returns per-node applied_version (masked) so support can triage faster.

anna: thanks all. I'll flag in the console release notes and coordinate with sales/support for impacted customers. :thumbsup:
